reviewItem.question: Does "Compatibility with cert-manager's `istio-csr`: In this release, Istio introduces increased validation checks in gRPC communication to the control plane" mean a change to protocol-behavior:istio|name=grpc-control-plane-alpn-validation (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 introduces increased validation checks in gRPC communication to the control plane that are incompatible with cert-manager's istio-csr versions prior to v0.12.1, causing authentication handshake failures.
